info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Poplar Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Poplar Recliner Details Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed information regarding Poplar Recliners within the catalog. This API allows businesses to add specific attributes such as dimensions, materials, and features that are crucial for customer decision-making. Retailers and catalog managers typically utilize this API to enhance their product offerings and ensure that the information presented to customers is comprehensive and accurate. By using this API, companies can streamline their inventory management processes and improve customer satisfaction through detailed product descriptions.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit details for the Poplar Recliner. Ensure all relevant information is provided to successfully register the recliner details in the system.
